title: NavBar
description: Native mobile navigation bar with accessible controls and shared design tokens.

props.name: title
props.description: Title in the middle (a string is rendered as a header Text)

props.name: leftText
props.description: Text of the left (back) button

props.name: leftArrow
props.description: Shows a back chevron in the left button

props.name: left
props.description: Custom left content, replacing the back button

props.name: rightText
props.description: Text of the right button (pressable with `onPressRight`)

props.name: right
props.description: Custom right content (e.g. icon buttons), replacing `rightText`

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the back button

props.name: safeAreaInsetTop
props.description: Pads the bar with the top safe-area inset (status bar / notch) of `MinervaProvider`

props.name: border
props.description: Hairline border under the bar

props.name: titleStyle
props.description: Style of the title text

events.name: onPressRight
events.description: Called by the right text button
